title: Surgical Site Infection in Perforated Appendicitis After Peritoneal Lavage With Super-oxidised Solution
brief_summary: This study is to evaluate the effectiveness of peritoneal lavage with super-oxidised solution in reducing surgical site infection after open surgery for perforated appendicitis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients between the age 13 and 70 years
2. Diagnosed with perforated appendicitis intra-operatively
3. Undergo open appendicectomy via Lanz incision

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Surgical technique: Laparoscopic appendicectomy or mid-line laparotomy
2. Patients on steroid treatment and immunosuppressant therapy.
